Want to experience the nano-texture feel of an iPad screen, but not ready to commit? Astropad has launched a brand-new version of Rock Paper Pencil, retaining the detachable design while adding a second writing feel.

Apple Pencil plus iPad can now offer the feel of a pencil — the all-new Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is here

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 pairs a screen protector with nano-texture with a specially-made Apple Pencil tip. For the first time, buyers can choose between two options: the smooth feel of a ballpoint pen, or the soft, higher-friction drag of graphite.

The new graphite tip simulates the feel of a 2B pencil, adding extra friction to meet the needs of artists sketching, shading, and expressing brushwork.

Astropad said that developing this new option took about a year, using a standard 2B pencil as the reference benchmark. The company also said the finished product recreates the visual and sound effects of real graphite.

Ballpoint or standard pencil feel — your choice

The original steel ballpoint tip is retained, suitable for writing, line work, fine-line drawing, and neat note-taking. Each set of Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 now comes with four Apple Pencil tips: two ballpoint tips and two graphite tips.

The screen protector itself remains unchanged. Astropad's proprietary NanoCling system uses static adhesion instead of glue, so it can be applied, removed, and reused at any time without leaving any residue.

The company says this adhesion is stronger than magnets, while also supporting bubble-free application and easy removal. The protector's micro-texture mimics the feel of fine-grain paper, providing friction and better control.

The best matte screen protector for iPad

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is more than just changing the Apple Pencil tip or altering the screen texture — it treats both as an integrated system. Astropad says the special tips are designed specifically for the nano-texture protector. The new graphite tips are made of POM, while the ballpoint tips use steel.

Rock Paper Pencil 4.0 is now on sale, priced at US$49.99, with free global shipping. The 3.0 version is also available simultaneously, sold while stocks last, with discount offers.
